questions.question: What is the 'AWS Abuse Team' responsible for?

options.B: Handling reports regarding AWS resources being used for malicious purposes (spam, DDoS, etc.)

questions.question: What is 'AWS Professional Services'?

options.A: A team of janitors for the data center
options.B: A global team of experts that can help you realize your desired business outcomes when using AWS
options.C: A special software suite for banks
options.D: A premium version of the AWS CLI

questions.question: Which service is a managed DDoS protection service that is available for all AWS customers at no additional cost for Layer 3 and 4 attacks?

options.B: AWS Shield Standard

questions.question: What is 'AWS IQ'?

options.B: A service that enables customers to find, engage, and pay AWS Certified third-party experts for project work
options.C: A tool to measure the intelligence of an AI

questions.question: What is 'AWS Managed Services' (AMS)?

options.A: A way for AWS to manage your on-premises servers
options.B: A service that operates AWS infrastructure on your behalf, providing a secure and compliant landing zone
options.C: A manual for using the console
options.D: A tool to group accounts together

questions.question: Which service helps you discover which of your applications are best candidates for migration and the dependencies between them?

options.B: AWS DataSync

questions.question: What is 'AWS DataSync'?

options.A: A social network for data scientists
options.B: An online data transfer service that simplifies, automates, and accelerates moving data between on-premises and AWS
options.C: A way to sync your laptop to the cloud
options.D: A tool for deleting duplicate files

questions.question: Which migration strategy involves 'retiring' redundant applications during the move to the cloud?

options.B: Retire

questions.question: Which AWS Support plan is recommended if you have production workloads and need a 1-hour response time for urgent cases?

options.B: Business

questions.question: What is the purpose of 'Concierge Support' in the Enterprise plan?

options.A: To park your car at AWS offices
options.B: A dedicated team to help with billing and account inquiries
options.C: A team to write code for you
options.D: A security guard for your VPC

questions.question: What is the 'AWS Partner Network' (APN)?

options.B: A global community of partners that leverage AWS to build solutions and services for customers

questions.question: What is 'AWS Local Zones'?

options.B: A type of AWS infrastructure deployment that places compute, storage, and other services closer to end users in specific geographic locations
options.C: A backup for the master node

questions.question: Which tool provides a customized view of the health of the specific AWS services powering your workloads?

options.B: AWS Personal Health Dashboard

questions.question: What is 'AWS Compute Optimizer' primarily analyzing to make recommendations?

options.B: Utilization data from CloudWatch (CPU, Memory, etc.)
options.D: The number of users logged in

options.B: S3 Intelligent-Tiering

questions.question: What is 'AWS Cost Categories'?

options.A: A list of things AWS sells
options.B: A feature that allows you to group your cost and usage information into meaningful categories based on your organization's structure

options.B: Managing software licenses from vendors like Microsoft, SAP, Oracle, and IBM

questions.question: What is 'AWS CloudShell'?

options.A: A physical shell from the beach
options.B: A browser-based, pre-authenticated shell that you can use to manage AWS resources

questions.question: Which migration strategy involves keeping an application on-premises for now because it is too complex or not ready for the cloud?

options.B: Retain

options.B: A way to connect your Direct Connect connection to one or more VPCs in different Regions

questions.question: What is 'Amazon Route 53' Resolver?

options.B: A service that provides recursive DNS queries for your VPC and on-premises networks

questions.question: What is 'AWS AppStream 2.0'?

options.B: A fully managed non-persistent desktop and application streaming service

questions.question: What is 'Amazon WorkSpaces'?

options.A: A desk in an Amazon office
options.B: A managed, secure Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) solution

options.B: AWS Pricing Calculator

options.A: A service to buy new mainframes

questions.question: What is 'AWS Application Migration Service' (MGN)?

options.A: A service to move your phone apps

questions.question: Which AWS Support plan includes access to 'Infrastructure Event Management' for an additional fee?

options.B: Business

options.B: A collection of the most frequent questions and requests from AWS customers and the answers to them
